mapper.sql: id, team_id, team_name, leader_id, description, avatar_url, status, member_count, max_member_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
select
from team where leader_id = #{leaderId} order by create_time desc limit 1

select distinct t.id, t.team_id, t.team_name, t.leader_id, t.description, t.avatar_url, t.status, t.member_count, t.max_member_count, t.create_time, t.update_time from team t inner join team_member tm on t.team_id = tm.team_id where tm.user_id = #{userId} and t.status = 'active' order by t.create_time desc limit 1

select distinct t.id, t.team_id, t.team_name, t.leader_id, t.description, t.avatar_url, t.status, t.member_count, t.max_member_count, t.create_time, t.update_time from team t inner join team_member tm on t.team_id = tm.team_id where tm.user_id = #{userId} and tm.role = 'member' order by t.create_time desc

select distinct t.id, t.team_id, t.team_name, t.leader_id, t.description, t.avatar_url, t.status, t.member_count, t.max_member_count, t.create_time, t.update_time from team t inner join team_member tm on t.team_id = tm.team_id where tm.user_id = #{userId} and tm.team_id = #{teamId} and tm.role = 'member' limit 1
mapper.update: update team set team_name = #{teamName}, description = #{description}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, status = #{status}, member_count = #{memberCount}, max_member_count = #{maxMemberCount}, update_time = #{updateTime} where team_id = #{teamId}
